units.source_text: 吴清源的病房位于正门上方的二楼，一边犄角上铺了两块榻榻米。

en.t: Go Seigen's hospital room was on the second floor above the main entrance, and two tatami mats had been laid in one corner.

units.source_text: 小小的木板棋盘架在组装的木腿上，上面铺了一块小垫子。

en.t: A small wooden go board was set on assembled wooden legs, with a little cushion spread over it.

units.source_text: 吴六段边摆小棋子边解说。

en.t: Wu, the sixth-dan player, explained as he arranged the small stones.
